The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ecaeb31108feca6f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 43-44. statement: Let JN be random real symmetric matrices whose conditional law, given their eigenvalues, is the orthogonal orbit measure. Let μ be a fixed compactly supported probability measure. If the empirical spectral measures converge weakly to μ in probability and the two edge excesses 43 in Proposition 7.3 tend to zero in probability, then PN → F(μ) in probability. If these spectral hypotheses hold almost surely, the pressure convergence holds almost surely. In either case, if the random variables PN are uniformly integrable, then EPN → F(μ). A sufficient condition for this last hypothesis is uniform integrability of ∥JN ∥op, in particular a uniform deterministic bound on these norms.
